idea-plugin.name: ERB Snippets + View Audit for Rails
idea-plugin.description:
Paste or open one .html.erb view and see every raw, html_safe, params and CSRF finding a Rails security review sends back — 26 rules, 36 snippets, offline in the editor, no account.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → ERB Snippets + View Audit for Rails: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 26 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/erb-rails-view-snippets-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/erb-rails-view-snippets-audit

action.text: ERB Snippets + View Audit for Rails: Check This File
action.description: Run ERB Snippets + View Audit for Rails on the file in the editor
